risk.description: high: a mistake would be costly or hard to notice; low: contained, tested, easy to verify.

risk_reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences, naming files or behaviour.

door.description: one_way: hard to undo once merged and released; two_way: reverting the commit undoes it.

door_reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences, naming files or behaviour.

security_findings.description: Security problems the change introduces or exposes; empty when there are none.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root; empty if none.

line.description: Line in the file, or null.

message.description: What is wrong and why it matters.
